2608.03468.title: ToolLIFT: Lifting Tool-Specific Trajectories into Function-Level Graphs for Generalizable Tool Planning
2608.03468.paper_summary: Historical tool-use trajectories provide valuable experience for large language model (LLM) agents to plan and coordinate tool usage. Existing approaches directly construct tool-level graphs from these trajectories, but the resulting graphs remain tied to specific tools and are hard to generalize across tool sets. To tackle this challenge, we find that despite differences in the tools involved, analogous tasks often share a common function-level workflow structure, which serves as a potentially more transferable abstraction for tool planning. Based on this insight, we propose ToolLIFT, a framework that lifts tool-specific trajectories into a function-level workflow graph (FWG) for generalizable tool planning. Specifically, we first propose a trajectory-lifting mechanism that encodes workflow structures in the FWG and shares collaboration experience across tools. Then, building on the global structure of the FWG, we introduce decoupled workflow planning and tool selection to align individual tool choices with the overall workflow. Lastly, to ensure reliable tool dataflow, we adopt Reinforcement Learning (RL) and propose source-gated and skill-specific rewards to maintain source-traceable information flow across tool calls. Experiments on two in-distribution (ID) and three out-of-distribution (OOD) benchmarks show that ToolLIFT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, demonstrating strong generalization to unseen tool sets.
2608.03468.paper_summary_zh: 歷史工具使用軌跡為大型語言模型（LLM）代理提供了寶貴的經驗，以計劃和協調工具使用。現有的方法直接從這些軌跡構建工具級圖，但結果圖仍然與特定工具相關，且難以在工具集之間進行泛化。為了解決這一挑戰，我們發現儘管所涉及的工具存在差異，類似的任務通常共享一個共同的功能級工作流程結構，這為工具規劃提供了一個潛在的更具可轉移性的抽象。基於這一見解，我們提出了ToolLIFT，一個將工具特定軌跡提升為功能級工作流程圖（FWG）的框架，以實現可泛化的工具規劃。具體而言，我們首先提出了一種軌跡提升機制，該機制在FWG中編碼工作流程結構，並在工具之間共享協作經驗。然後，基於FWG的全局結構，我們引入了解耦的工作流程規劃和工具選擇，以將個別工具選擇與整體工作流程對齊。最後，為了確保可靠的工具數據流，我們採用了強化學習（RL），並提出了源門控和技能特定的獎勵，以維持工具調用之間的源可追溯信息流。在兩個內分佈（ID）和三個外分佈（OOD）基準上的實驗顯示，ToolLIFT始終超越最先進的基線，展現出對未見工具集的強大泛化能力。
